techniques.application: Separated semantic trust, visible adapter behavior, full Body War proof, and reusable projections.
Split 23 units by one primary independently observable behavior and deterministic successor.
Ordered semantic prerequisites before UI-profile admission, renderer, Body War build, full acceptance, and portability.
Compiled the digest-bound DomainSpec development profile into an OEW-owned UI API without runtime dependency or authority transfer.
Kept candidate UI classifications non-authoritative and required zero runtime imports from projects/domainspec-v2.
Mapped prior tuple loss, card substitution, black-box density, and bundle surgery to explicit gates.
Carried thirteen executable toy-game failures into terminal acceptance rather than treating positive counts as sufficient.
Selected pure source normalization first, proved complete linear/index fallback before spatial activation, and delayed build cutover until source and adapter contracts pass.
